1.why: Text throughout the interface uses a clean, highly legible sans-serif font with standard letter and line spacing.

2.why: Instructions consistently use plain sentence case without italics, all-caps text blocks, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: Content is neatly contained in central cards that remain clear and readable, though captured on a wide desktop viewport.

4.why: Instructional text across all steps is concise, direct, and written in plain language.

5.why: The authenticator code input field on step 5 lacks a placeholder or inline example showing the expected six-digit format.

6.why: The interface presents content in brief sentences, ensuring users never have to read long text blocks to proceed.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard buttons are provided for the manual Base32 secret or the set of recovery codes.

8.why: The system requires manual text entry of the Base32 secret and offers no QR code option for authenticator apps.

9.why: Input fields use standard text elements, but no explicit OTP autocomplete or password manager support attributes are visually indicated.

10.why: Each page clearly displays the current step title at the top of the card and highlights the primary call-to-action button in blue.

11.why: Screens present a single main primary action button per step to keep the user focused.

12.why: The application provides clear headings and status updates, such as 'MFA is active', after each action.

13.why: Users can view or regenerate recovery codes, but no options exist to hide or reveal sensitive secrets on screen.

14.why: No error states or error messages are shown in any of the provided screenshots to confirm helpful guidance.

15.why: There are no countdown timers or time restrictions displayed on screen during reading or code entry.
